notes.title: 1.6 Update
notes.content:
Level fixes, level tweaks and bug fixes

[h2]Level fix[/h2]
- Level 2  minor graphic fix
- Level 1, 3, 4, 5, 5v2 tweaks
[h2]
Bug fixes[/h2]
- When press ESC on tank upgrade menus or free coin menu goes back overworld (not show quit menu)
- Fix Remix mode, unable to press using controller or keyboard
- Fix menu not all button hover not same brininess
- Quit menu hover button brininess fix
- Optimize game size, now 60 mb less space
